scope: One preview-only delivery probe; not a booking or money operation and not production email acceptance.
recipientRule: Use only the named recipient explicitly authorized by Kye. Do not store their address in the public repository.

message.subject: DriveDrop preview — email delivery check
message.heading: DriveDrop test notification
message.body:
This is the agreed DriveDrop preview email delivery check.

Please confirm in ChatGPT whether it reached your inbox or spam folder.
message.preheader: One test notification for the payment-readiness review.

beforeSending: Confirm the named recipient, sender verification, existing preview sending access and exact rendered preview link.
Keep production credentials and email flags unchanged; use the existing application template without introducing a public test-send endpoint.
evidenceRequired: Record provider acceptance separately from actual recipient delivery.
Obtain recipient inbox/spam confirmation and check the rendered link.
Keep credentials, recipient address and private message content out of public evidence.
